papers.title: FiberGuard Finite-Fibre Certification
papers.current_ceiling: V3-C1–C7 theory remains the ceiling; the PMLB revival lanes are adverse and do not validate the registered geometry.
post_matrix_updates: PR #1732 is an open statistical correction: 32/44 versus 39/44 is paired, exact McNemar p≈0.0923 and a 20,000-replicate paired bootstrap interval includes zero. The raw count difference must not be called decisive while that PR is open.
load_bearing_adverse: R23 geometry coverage is 32/44, below the frozen 0.95 gate; the lexical control is 39/44 but the paired superiority claim is not statistically established.
R24 reaches 44/44 coverage but its certificate is invalid, with 20/44 strict held-out violations.
V3-C11 shows the registered alpha=.10 full-coverage goal is arithmetically infeasible on the accessed data.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: A new external family must test whether finite-fibre geometry predicts certifiability and valid selective coverage beyond the PMLB-specific representation, against equally tuned non-geometric controls.
papers.decisive_question: On a prospectively frozen OpenML-CC18 subset, does a fibre-geometry certificate identify valid high-coverage strata that cannot be matched by resource-equal lexical or generic conformal selectors?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Finite-fibre geometry supplies a transferable, validity-preserving structural predictor of certifiability, with explicit regimes where it abstains or offers no advantage.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The geometry arm should improve the Pareto frontier of valid coverage versus abstention on pre-declared strata, while never exceeding the registered violation budget; no claim is licensed merely by beating a control in raw counts.
papers.population_or_universe: All OpenML-CC18 tasks satisfying prospectively frozen schema, sample-size, label and licensing rules, partitioned before any outcome access.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Dataset × split × registered arm, with paired decisions on identical held-out examples.
design: Use a new identity and freeze an all-eligible or rule-sampled OpenML-CC18 corpus.
Derive fibre structures from training partitions only and keep held-out labels inaccessible to all selectors.
Compare geometry, lexical and generic conformal arms under identical tuning budgets and feature access.
Predeclare validity, coverage and utility estimands, including per-dataset paired contrasts and hierarchical uncertainty.
Retain null/no-value strata and certificate failures as first-class terminals.
baselines: Strongest donor finite-fibre or local-density method found by the novelty audit.
primary_endpoints: Strict held-out violation rate with simultaneous uncertainty.
Utility/regret under a prospectively supplied abstention cost.
negative_controls: Permuted fibre membership preserving class balance.
Geometry-free lexical selector with identical hyperparameter budget.
Known infeasible alpha/task cells that must yield abstention or CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Paired per-task contrasts, exact tests where discordant counts are small and bootstrap intervals with frozen seeds.
Family-wise control across primary co-endpoints or a closed testing procedure fixed before outcomes.
No secondary metric can rescue a failed validity gate.
Report task heterogeneity and leave-one-task-family-out sensitivity.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use every eligible prospectively pinned task where practical; otherwise power the paired task-level design for the smallest practically meaningful coverage gain while preserving the noncompensatory validity bound.
papers.success_gate: The geometry arm satisfies the frozen validity gate, improves the valid-coverage/utility frontier against every donor-complete comparator, and the effect persists across predeclared task strata.
papers.refutation_gate: Any validity breach, failure to beat the donor product, or concentration in one post hoc subgroup supports only the bounded theory/adverse result.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if task identity, split custody, tuning budget, certificate semantics or per-example paired records are missing.
papers.authority_required: Independent algebraic-statistics review plus an evaluator implementation that does not import the training/selection code.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not duplicate or pre-empt #1732, and do not call the new study an R23/R24 rescue.

immediate_safe_actions: Adopt #1732 only after review, preserving both adverse terminals.
Draft OpenML eligibility and task-family rules without reading candidate outcomes.
Commission the independent algebraic-statistics review of V3-C1–C7.
forbidden_actions: Do not assert lexical-control superiority from 39/44 versus 32/44.
Do not lower the old 0.95 gate or reuse PMLB as fresh confirmation.
Do not treat coverage without certificate validity as success.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier statistics/methodology paper needs valid selective guarantees, paired external evidence, strong controls, uncertainty at the task level and an honest no-value regime.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns fibre geometry and certifiability; generic state value belongs to ORION-08 and computation placement to ORION-21.
